_help: dos: my rules to keep. blocks: the timeline blocks that prove the habit (adherence is read from them).
daily: true means it has no clock time and shows in the Habits checklist on Today.
days: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday, or the word work / muayThai to follow Settings.
auto: water means it is kept automatically when the water counter reaches the target.
donts: things to avoid. Three of them are asked every evening. weeklyAllowance: slips per week that are still fine.
system: true means the app enforces it itself, it is never asked.
